summary: Prepare coherent proposals with LFA tools, indicators and budget logic. Review the course outline and see how it fits your work.
lede: Logical Framework Approach proposal preparation helps teams turn funding calls and project concepts into coherent, evidence-linked applications. It is for project officers, proposal writers and programme leads who need to check call requirements and connect project needs to activities, results and costs. You will practise building a compliance matrix, linking problem analysis to a results chain, and drafting indicators with feasible verification sources.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who contribute directly to funding applications, from call analysis and project design through budget review and proposal quality assurance.
modules: LFA Proposal Fit and Call Analysis
Theory of Change and Results Pathways
prerequisites: Working knowledge of project concepts and basic proposal development is expected. No coding or programming is required.
